thought.text: OIDC login end-to-end works. Let me test an authenticated API call through oauth2-proxy to confirm the full path.

reasoning_content:
Full OIDC login flow works: oauth2-proxy → Keycloak → callback → /app/ returns the SPARK Workflow app HTML. This confirms the end-to-end browser login described in the guide.

Now I can also test an authenticated API call through oauth2-proxy using the session cookie. Let me try hitting /pls/v1/project-statuses through port 3000 with the cookie. Actually oauth2-proxy routes API paths? Let me check the oauth2-proxy config routes. The frontend uses base URL FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000 and paths like /pls/v1. So oauth2-proxy must proxy /pls/v1 to vite. Let me test.

action.command:
cd /tmp
echo "=== authenticated API through oauth2-proxy :3000 ==="
curl -s -b cj.txt -o /tmp/api.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 http://localhost:3000/pls/v1/project-statuses
echo "--- body ---"; head -c 500 /tmp/api.json; echo
echo "=== keycloak userinfo via oauth2-proxy ==="
curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 10 http://localhost:3000/oauth2/userinfo
